selection_rule: seeded round-robin over strata; prefer unused movements/lights/junctions; reuse only when a stratum is exhausted; never uses driving outcomes
exclusion_rule: movements whose planned route crosses a stop trigger covering only junction-internal lanes
traffic_seed_rule: run with --seed BASE --seed-per-route: seed = BASE + route_id
location_reuse_rule: stop-sign family reuses locations across seeds; intervals must be clustered by junction/stop location
